phases.name: Validate Demand & Feasibility
actions: Conduct focus groups & surveys with ≥20 corporate accounts in two target office parks.
Map the full licensing workflow with municipal authorities and draft a realistic timeline.
Run ingredient‑price sensitivity models at INR 120‑150 per meal to test margin viability.
phases.gate: Go if ≥70% of surveyed accounts express willingness to pay ≥INR 120 and licensing timeline ≤8 weeks.
risks_addressed: Uncertain willingness to pay premium for healthy meals.
Margin compression from ingredient price volatility.

phases.name: Pilot Execution
actions: Launch cloud kitchen in the secured 200‑sq‑ft space with management software & POS integration (c155).
Partner with a delivery service guaranteeing <20‑minute deliveries within each park (c154).
Offer subscription meals at INR 130 and track order volume, delivery times, and customer satisfaction.
phases.gate: Proceed if average delivery time ≤30 min, repeat order rate ≥40%, and contribution margin ≥5% over the pilot period.

phases.name: Scale & Optimize
actions: Expand to additional office parks within 5 km radius, replicating the proven kitchen‑delivery model.
Negotiate bulk ingredient contracts to lock prices and mitigate volatility (c137).
Implement AI‑driven menu optimization and dynamic pricing to improve margins (c187).
phases.gate: Scale if monthly revenue ≥ INR 5 million with sustained contribution margin ≥8% and regulatory compliance maintained across all locations.
risks_addressed: Ingredient cost volatility at larger scale.
Maintaining service quality across multiple sites.

plan.first_step: Map the municipal licensing process, secure a 200‑sq‑ft kitchen lease within budget, and negotiate a third‑party delivery partner for the target office parks.
